main_text.p: ignominiosam quam acerbam, & qui mortuos ad vitam refuscitauit, ipse vi-tæ fons mortem patienter tulit ; qui li-ctores ad se apprehēdendū accedentes voce sola prostrauit, sententia mortis contra se lata, ne querulam vocem e-misit,qui denique plusquam duodecim legiones Angelorum, semper in pro-cinctu habuit ad suppetias ferendas, ne gladium quidem in iuftiffima fui de-fenfione contra iniuftos fycophantas,& afaffinos cuaginari voluit; imo auricu-lam ferui Principis Sacerdotum ampu-tatam, miraculosè denuò fanauit. Ideò proftrauit (inquitDe passione Domini.{i}Bernardus) vt potentiam oftenderet, ideò fanauit vt potentiam pariter & obedientiam, vtcunque malitiosè simul & mendaciter, illi ob-truderent Iudæi, quod Cæfari contradiceret, cùm priùs tamen ipfe {k}CæfariMat. 17., quæ fuerunt Cæfaris, (cenfum licèt indebitum foluendo) tribueret, & alios etiam tribuere palam {l}hortaretur;licètMar. 12. tum temporis{m}Tiberius Cæfar obfcoena foedaque libidine,cædibus item & periurio fupra modum infamis effet; ita fe geffit Saluator nofter, cuius omnis actioVide S[?]et.in eius vita. noftra

page.notes: Left column is blank. "querulam" is read as printed; a doubtful letter form, not certain. The text runs on from the previous page, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The reference marks i, k, l and m are placed in the text where they stand. The left note for m is read as "Vide S[?]et." (possibly Suet.), as the second letter is unclear.
